description: Plan spells for a D&D 5e character. Shows available spells for a class at a given level, tracks spell slots, flags concentration conflicts, highlights rituals, and sums material component costs.

prepared_spells.description: List of spell names you plan to prepare. If provided, analyzes conflicts and costs.

remaining_slots.description: Remaining spell slots as an object mapping spell level (string) to count, e.g. {"1": 3, "2": 1}

name: plan_spells
